purpose: Seven-dimension claim-to-artifact map for reviewer navigation; not a self-awarded score

check: three scope levels transmit one public-dividend claim rather than three unrelated plans
three brief roles become safety, open-maintenance and everyday-service outputs
five proposed regional interfaces share de-located methods rather than invented partnerships
official park facts, provisional design geometry and field results are never conflated
AI OFF, CITY ON treats technological exit as a spatial design requirement
BASE, BOOST, BLACKOUT and BEQUEST connect ordinary service, bounded gain, physical unplug and residual civic asset
three yards produce different post-AI legacies rather than three copies of an AI showroom
the concept departs from v3 time-rights framing and does not copy peer brands or protocols
12 contracts each declare human authority, allowed and prohibited data, ordinary service, physical unplug, recovery evidence and a non-AI bequest
12 contracts by 7 synthetic branches produce 84 reproducible cases
60 incomplete or prohibited branches fail closed; 12 normal and 12 blackout branches enter separate human reviews
runner uses zero real personal-data cases and performs no network or device I/O
field performance remains null and machine PASS is not presented as field success
first slice starts with two weeks of non-AI baseline and ordinary full-scale prototypes before shadow or bounded AI
Week 8 is a physical City Unplug Day followed by maintenance, distribution and independent review
G0-G7 project maturity and C0-C7 scenario admission remain independent gates
10 roles separate public stewardship, safety, operations, maintenance and independent evaluation
9 projects identify accountable roles and unknown resources without claiming funding or approval
ordinary routes and human, paper and telephone access precede AI activation
each scenario identifies a non-AI equivalent and a residual public asset
affected people and nonparticipants retain stop, appeal and ordinary-service rights
accessibility, quiet, labor, safety and data rights may stop service independently
benefit and burden distribution remains an open field measure rather than a claimed score
provisional boundary, key areas and concept geometry are explicitly non-statutory
missing controls, ownership, fire, heritage, ecology, utilities and resources remain gates
prohibited data and missing human, baseline, unplug or bequest fields fail closed
no approval, partnership, procurement, capacity or field-performance claim is made
GPT Image 2 assets are text-free, individually disclosed and excluded from the evidence order
bilingual proposals carry identical evidence-anchor multisets
five bilingual core figures independently cover overall, land-use, focus-area, mobility-blue-green and metric evidence
20-page A3 booklets and 7-board A0 sets are searchable, bilingual and lead with the core claim
offline HTML has 12 stable V4 locators, responsive interaction, reduced-motion handling, captions and no remote dependency
manifest language counterparts, neutral text-free media and all file digests are finalised after rendering

known_open_checks: official geometry, statutory controls, ownership, existing-building survey, utility, fire, heritage, ecology and accessibility inputs remain pending
named role holders, authorised operator, field capacity, labour plan, budget, procurement, insurance and professional sign-off remain pending
all service, recovery, accessibility, maintenance and benefit-burden field metrics remain null until an authorised trial

spatial_contract.validation: The 28 v4 constraint features are three provisional dividend-yard polygons, six unplugged-seam polygons, twelve scenario representative points and seven component locators. Official spatial_review must pass; the three source key-area polygons remain explicitly provisional and are not treated as official redlines or precise-area evidence.
